scope: Protected confirmatory trial windows and explicit per-window budgets. Exploratory analysis is not authorized by this registry.
authorization_rule: A confirmatory trial requires an exact-scope human PROTECTED_TRIAL approval. Q1-2027 additionally requires a Q1_PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT from the configured owner, an active protocol ADR, and a positive explicit budget. An exhausted budget requires a recorded budget increase and matching TRIAL_BUDGET_AMENDMENT from the configured owner; an approval by itself does not create capacity.
